summary: Performance Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the extension of a time charter for the M/T Briolette with Aramco Trading at a gross rate of US$37,700 per day for 35 months +/- 30 days, commencing July 2, 2026. The charter is expected to generate approximately US$39 million in gross revenue. This is a routine commercial contract renewal, not a special situation, as it involves operational disclosure of a vessel charter extension with no change in corporate structure, no acquisition/divestiture, and no extraordinary event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of material contract terms.
